examples.japanese: {昼|ひる}ご{飯|はん}を{食|た}べましたか。
{昼|ひる}ご{飯|はん}は{何|なに}にしますか。
examples.english: What will you have for lunch?

examples.japanese: 12{時|じ}に{昼|ひる}ご{飯|はん}を{食|た}べます。

notes:
{昼|ひる}ご{飯|はん} is the informal word for lunch, the midday meal.

MEAL VOCABULARY:
- {朝|あさ}ご{飯|はん}: breakfast
- {昼|ひる}ご{飯|はん}: lunch
- {晩|ばん}ご{飯|はん}/{夜|よる}ご{飯|はん}: dinner

ALTERNATIVE EXPRESSIONS:
- {昼食|ちゅうしょく}: lunch (formal, often used in business)
- ランチ: lunch (casual, from English)
- お{昼|ひる}: lunch (casual abbreviation)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {昼|ひる}ご{飯|はん}を{食|た}べる: to eat lunch
- {昼|ひる}ご{飯|はん}に{行|い}く: to go for lunch
- {昼|ひる}ご{飯|はん}は{何|なに}にする?: What shall we have for lunch?

USAGE NOTE:
ご{飯|はん} literally means 'cooked rice' but is commonly used to mean 'meal'. In casual speech, お{昼|ひる} alone can mean lunch: お{昼|ひる}{食|た}べた? (Did you eat lunch?)
